name: Vowel morph pad (E-flat minor)
desc: Slow vowel-morphing sawtooth pad in D#/Eb minor: a five-vowel <a e i o u> sequence crawls across a five-cycle span while a four-chord i-VII-III-v progression re-triggers 2-4x per cycle. Opposite-phase lpf and pan sweeps over 16-32 cycles; peak runs the sanctioned saw-pump re-trigger so the choir ducks under the kick. Formant-shifting braindance haze.

code.full: note("<[eb3,bb3,gb4]*2 [db3,ab3,f4]*2 [gb2,db3,bb3]*2 [bb2,f3,db4]*2>").add(note(${root})).s("sawtooth").vowel("<a e i o u a e o>").attack(.08).decay(.5).sustain(.5).release(.3).lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.6, ${cut}*1.4).slow(32)).gain(${gain}*.9).pan(sine.range(.35,.65).slow(24)).room(${room}).orbit(6).play()
code.peak: note("<[eb3,bb3,gb4]*4 [db3,ab3,f4]*4 [gb2,db3,bb3]*4 [bb2,f3,db4]*4>").add(note(${root})).s("sawtooth").vowel("<a e i o u a e i>").attack(.05).decay(.4).sustain(.3).release(.15).lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.8, ${cut}*1.6).slow(16)).gain(saw.range(${gain}*.35, ${gain}).fast(4)).pan(cosine.range(.3,.7).slow(24)).room(${room}).orbit(6).play()
